aiw_prompt.definition: The instruction and the context you give a model. Writing a good one is a real skill, not a magic formula.
aiw_prompt.example: A one-line prompt gave me a generic answer; a prompt with the audience and the length gave me a usable one.

borrowed_competence.definition: Results and confidence produced by tools, which the user experiences as personal ability.

manufactured_consent.definition: Agreement produced not by open discussion but by arranging the information environment so one conclusion appears natural.

register.definition: The level of formality a speaker chooses for a situation, from casual to formal.
register.example: Switching register, he changed *Could you pass the salt* to *Pass the salt*.

rinse_aid.definition: A liquid added to the wide compartment of the drawer that makes water sheet off the dishes so they dry without spots.
rinse_aid.example: The rinse aid symbol is lit, so I need to top up the wide compartment.

windy.definition: The air is moving fast. A windy day can be hot or freezing.
windy.example: It is windy, so my hat keeps blowing away.
